clinic.heroSubtitle: Restore your smile, regain full chewing function, and enjoy lasting confidence with Dental implants from Bayport Dental Care. This innovative procedure offers a permanent solution for missing or failing teeth, often delivered in a single day, helping preserve jawbone health and providing teeth that look and function like natural ones. Our use of AI-centric technology and comprehensive imaging ensures precise diagnostics and personalized treatment plans for your optimal oral health.

treatmentJourney.title: Consultation & 3D Imaging
treatmentJourney.description: Your journey begins with a full consultation, including CBCT 3D imaging, to comprehensively assess your oral health and jawbone structure. This allows for precise digital surgical planning.

treatmentJourney.title: Digital Surgical Planning
treatmentJourney.description: Based on your 3D scans, a detailed digital surgical plan is created, and your temporary bridge is meticulously fabricated in our lab, tailored to your unique smile.

treatmentJourney.title: Surgical Day & New Teeth
treatmentJourney.description: On your surgical day, any remaining failing teeth are removed, four dental implants are strategically placed, and your fixed temporary teeth are delivered, often allowing you to walk out with a new smile.

treatmentJourney.title: Healing & Osseointegration
treatmentJourney.description: Over the next 3-6 months, your implants will heal and integrate with your jawbone, a process called osseointegration, ensuring a strong and stable foundation.

treatmentJourney.title: Final Prosthesis Design
treatmentJourney.description: Once healing is complete, impressions are taken, and your final permanent prosthesis is custom-designed, focusing on aesthetics, comfort, and optimal function.

treatmentJourney.title: Delivery & Long-Term Care
treatmentJourney.description: The final Implant teeth are delivered, providing you with a beautiful, permanent smile. We then provide a long-term hygiene plan to ensure the lasting success of your new teeth.

faqItems.question: How do dental implants work to replace missing teeth?
faqItems.answer: Dental implants are titanium posts surgically placed into the jawbone to act as artificial tooth roots. These posts fuse with the bone, providing a stable foundation for crowns, bridges, or full arches that look and function like natural teeth.

faqItems.question: Am I a good candidate for dental implants?
faqItems.answer: Most adults with missing or failing teeth are candidates for dental implants. Dr. Modgil will assess your oral health, including bone density, during an initial consultation to determine the best treatment plan for you, even if you have bone loss.

faqItems.question: How long does the dental implant process take from start to finish?
faqItems.answer: The entire dental implant process typically spans several months. This includes initial consultation and planning, surgical placement, a healing period for osseointegration, and finally, the placement of your permanent restoration.

faqItems.question: What are my options if I am missing several teeth?
faqItems.answer: If you are missing several teeth, we offer solutions like implant bridges or full arch restorations. Implant bridges can replace multiple adjacent teeth, while full arch options restore an entire set of teeth with just a few implants.

faqItems.question: What financial options are available for dental implants?
faqItems.answer: We offer an in-house dental discount plan, accept various dental insurances, and can assist with third-party financing to make your dental implant treatment affordable and accessible.

faqItems.question: Is the dental implant procedure painful?
faqItems.answer: Patient comfort is a top priority. We utilize effective local anesthesia during the surgical placement of implants, and sedation options are available to ensure a comfortable and stress-free experience.

doctor.name: Dr. Mohit Modgil
doctor.bio: Dr. Mohit Modgil, known to his patients as Dr. Moe, brings over 15 years of expertise and a passion for modern dentistry to Bayport Dental Care. Graduating with a Doctor of Dental Surgery (D.D.S.) with Perio Honors, he is committed to staying at the forefront of dental advancements. Dr. Moe's practice integrates cutting-edge technology, including AI-centric solutions and 3D imaging, to deliver precise diagnostics and personalized treatment plans. His patient-focused approach ensures comfort, confidence, and optimal oral health for every individual he treats.
